digest.component_or_area: metrics adapter — GitHub Actions coverage and CI-health harvest
propositions: Coverage % and CI-health (status, duration, red-to-green recovery, recheck rate) are lost after GHA's short log-retention window and must be harvested into a durable tracked store.
The GHA adapter must parse coverage from pytest-cov output in run-log tails and extract CI-health from run-metadata JSON without modifying the CI workflow permissions or adding commits from CI.
Harvested metrics must be persisted to the tracked `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` file (not `reports/`) as labeled snapshots via a local harvester script, not the workflow.
The GHA adapter must be isolated and optional so the core metrics command does not depend on it; core modules must never import the adapter.
